title: Event modal offers name, date, start/end time, an all-day toggle, and a color category
preconditions: 1. You are signed in on a desktop browser with Schedule: Edit.
2. You are on the Schedule page with the event modal open (via right-click 'New Event').
steps: 1. Read the fields the modal offers.
2. Fill each: name, date, start and end time, and pick a color category.
expected: 1. The modal contains: name, date, start/end time, an all-day toggle, and a color category.
2. The event saves with the entered values.
3. Re-opening the event shows the saved values.
